tools.name: dynapictures_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the DynaPictures workspaces the API key's user belongs to, with their id and role. Good first call: the workspace id is needed for templates and media. GET /workspaces.

tools.name: dynapictures_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates that have 'Sync to Zapier' enabled, with their uid, name and layer names. Layer names are what generate_image overrides. Optionally filter by workspace id. GET /templates.

tools.name: dynapictures_get_template
tools.description: Get one template by uid, with its layers (name, type, size, text). Use the layer names when you call generate_image or build_image_link. GET /templates/{uid}.

tools.name: dynapictures_search_generated_images
tools.description: Find images the caller's teams generated, oldest first, up to 200 per call. Filter by keyword, metadata text, or a start and end date. Use the date filters for large result sets. GET /generated-images.

tools.name: dynapictures_list_media_assets
tools.description: List the images and folders in a workspace's media library, 30 per page. Use the asset url in other tools or in generate_image layers. GET /media/{workspaceId}/assets.

tools.name: dynapictures_get_media_asset
tools.description: Get one media asset by id, with its url, thumbnail url, mime type and size. GET /media/{workspaceId}/assets/{assetId}.

tools.name: dynapictures_build_image_link
tools.description: Build a public image URL for a template with layer overrides, with no API call and no credit used. Paste it into an tag or a page; the image renders when the link is opened. Identical links return a cached image.

tools.name: dynapictures_generate_image
tools.description: Render a template with your data and return the image URL. Each image or PDF page uses one image credit. Requests are NOT idempotent: a repeated call uses another credit, so do not retry a call that may have succeeded. POST /designs/{uid}.

tools.name: dynapictures_upload_media_from_url
tools.description: Add an image to a workspace's media library from a public URL. The new asset can then be used in template layers. POST /media/{workspaceId}/assets/from-url.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dynapictures_list_media_assets, dynapictures_get_media_asset · Private data: dynapictures_list_workspaces · Public sink: dynapictures_generate_image, dynapictures_upload_media_from_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dynapictures_list_media_assets, dynapictures_get_media_asset · Private data: dynapictures_list_workspaces · Public sink: dynapictures_generate_image, dynapictures_upload_media_from_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
